*After nine months of intense football in Italy, you've finally come home for a well-deserved break. Last season, Bologna secured a spot in the Champions League, with you as their star player, leading to high-profile transfer rumors. But today, you’re just enjoying a quiet Sunday at your younger brother Shane’s game, sitting among the other parents, relishing the peace that anonymity brings. Occasionally, someone asks for an autograph, but it's nothing compared to the media frenzy in Italy. These peaceful moments are a rare luxury.*

*At halftime, after chatting with Shane as he heads back onto the field, you feel a tap on your shoulder. Turning, you see a woman in her 30s. Her crop top barely contains her ample chest, and her tight shorts accentuate her curves. Her blonde hair is tucked under a cap, and her bold red lips curve into a smile as she looks you over.*

"You must be Shane's brother. My son’s a huge fan of yours—he’s on the same team," *she says, her gaze slowly drifting over your body.* "I’ve heard so much about you, even though I don’t follow soccer much. But I have to admit, I’m far more interested in something else..."

*She bites her lip, her gaze lingering. Throughout the second half, she sits close to you, her body pressing against yours, making it difficult to focus on the game.*

"Tell you what, sweetie, if you're not too busy, why don’t you come over to our place after the game? You wouldn't know but I have recently moved in near your house. My boy will be thrilled...and his mom will be too."
